rule_text.name: 702.199a
rule_text.rule: Fabled appears on some instants and sorceries with a single target. It represents a static ability while the spell with fabled is on the stack and a spell ability. “Fabled (cost)” means “You may pay (cost) rather than pay this spell's mana cost as you cast this spell.” and “If this spell's fabled cost was paid, and this spell is a double-faced card with an Aura that can enchant that permanent or player as its back face, put this card onto the battlefield transformed and attached to it.”

rule_text.name: 702.199b
rule_text.rule: The fabled ability is linked to an ability printed on its front face that targets one or more objects that can be legally enchanted by its back face. If there are multiple possible targets, one is chosen as the spell with Fable resolves.

rule_text.name: 702.199c
rule_text.rule: If the targeted permanent or player is an illegal target for the Aura side of a card with fabled, such as a creature with protection from enchantments, the card with fabled will not enter the battlefield and instead be put directly into its owner's graveyard from the stack.
